name: Waterwalking
effect_text: Entering a water hex costs you 0 move at any level.

name: Flow State
effect_text: You and your allies standing in water get +3/+6/+9 avoid (water 1/2/3).

name: Current Push
effect_text: Attacking from water: +5/+10/+15% damage (water 1/2/3).

name: Tidal Guard
effect_text: While you stand in water: +15 glance chance per water level (15/30/45).

name: Undertow
effect_text: While you live and any water 3 is on the board, foes get +1 move toward the nearest water 3, normal move level with it and -1 move away from it.

name: Heat Rush
effect_text: No fire crossing damage. The first fire hex you enter each turn gives +1 move.

name: Ember Skin
effect_text: An adjacent foe that hits you while you stand on fire takes 2/4/6% (your fire 1/2/3). Your fire standing damage is halved.

name: Kindling
effect_text: +5/+10/+15% damage when you or the target stands on fire (the higher level counts).

name: Wildfire
effect_text: Your fresh fire at 2+ seeds fire 1 onto neutral neighbours on the next tick, once per cast. Grass containment still applies.

name: Coal Engine
effect_text: Allies (you included) starting their turn on fire 1/2/3 gain +1/+2/+3 move that turn.

name: Skate
effect_text: Glazed and stasis hexes cost you 1 move even on mud. +1 move when you start your turn on one.

name: Rime Armour
effect_text: -10% damage taken on a glazed or stasis hex; Shatter doesn't apply to you.

name: Fault Lines
effect_text: Your Shatter is +30% (base +15%) but your Shatter hit breaks the glaze.

name: Frostbite
effect_text: A foe starting its turn on glaze you laid is Drenched.

name: Frost Ward
effect_text: At the start of your turn the nearest unwarded ally within 2 (else you) gains a Frost Ward: it negates the next elemental effect on its holder, then breaks. One per unit.

name: Bolt Step
effect_text: After any action that detonates a tile: move 2 more.

name: Grounded
effect_text: Chain arcs reaching you deal half; detonation splash on you is halved. You're still conductive.

name: Overcharge
effect_text: An arc from a target you hit jumps again: a second arc at 50% of the first, to the next-nearest of that team. No unit is arced twice in one action.

name: Static Field
effect_text: Your fuses last 5 cycles (base 3). A foe ending its move on one is Staggered.

name: Lightning Rod
effect_text: An arc that would hit an ally within 3 of you hits you instead at 50%.

name: Tailwind
effect_text: +2 move when you start on a gale marker. After any wind action: move 1 more.

name: Eye of the Storm
effect_text: Immune to displacement. Bow, pistol and thrown attacks on you get -15 hit.

name: Gale Force
effect_text: +5% damage per hex you moved this turn (up to +20%).

name: Gust
effect_text: A foe hit by your wind skill is pushed 1 away; if something stops it, it slams for 8%.

name: Slipstream
effect_text: Allies starting their turn within 2 of you get +1 move.

name: Shadowstep
effect_text: Once per turn, from a dark hex, step to another dark hex within 3 for 1 move, ignoring the path.

name: Nightborn
effect_text: No dark drain on you. While you stand on dark, the first elemental effect each turn that would land on you is negated.

name: Ambush
effect_text: Attacking from dark 1/2/3: +5/+10/+15 crit.

name: Pall
effect_text: A foe you hit while it stands on dark 2+ is Blinded.

name: Cover of Night
effect_text: Attacks on allies adjacent to you get -7 hit.

name: Sunpath
effect_text: +1 move when you start on light; +2 on light 3.

name: Radiant Guard
effect_text: Light's hit bonus doesn't apply to attacks on you.

name: Judgement
effect_text: Your attacks on a foe standing on light can't glance.

name: Glare
effect_text: A foe starting its turn on light you laid isn't healed; on light 2+ it's also Blinded.

name: Sanctuary
effect_text: Your light heals allies 5/9/14% (base 3/6/9). Once per battle, when an ally within 3 drops under 35% HP, its hex gains light 2.
